ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized linear abrasions and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark blob covering the majority of both lobes; high-contrast white clustering is localized at the extreme distal tips and in isolated linear segments (rake marks) throughout the central and lateral lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by sharp peaks (amplitudes of 5-15 pixels) alternating with shallow valleys, particularly pronounced on the lateral halves of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-curving sweep with convex outer margins that transition into concave curvature approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; additional small, circular white points (rosettes) scattered near the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, vertically-oriented high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on both lobes, breaking the solid dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks across the mid-sections of both lobes and white scarring/pigmentation loss at the distal tips.
